title: System Architecture & Offline Execution
summary: TASC IIoT Studio operates 100% inside modern web browsers with zero desktop installation or SQL server requirements. Utilizes high-performance IndexedDB for multi-year time-series telemetry logging and localStorage for project configurations.

title: SCADA Dashboard & Web HMI Canvas
summary: Full vector HMI canvas supporting interactive industrial equipment symbols (pumps, chillers, valves, cooling towers, pipes, conveyor belts), real-time color animations, and responsive zoom/pan controls.

title: Industrial Communication Protocols (Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA)
summary: Connects to physical industrial hardware via native driver bridges. Supports Modbus TCP/RTU, standard MQTT JSON brokers, Sparkplug B, and OPC UA binary streams with millisecond telemetry polling.

title: Driver & MQTT Tag Management
summary: Unified tag dictionary with linear sensor scaling (y = mx + c), deadband noise suppression, raw register mapping, float32/int16 data type conversion, and live telemetry health status flags.

title: Real-Time Alarms & Safety Trip Interlocks
summary: IEC 62682 industrial alarm engine featuring 4-level limit thresholds (HH, H, L, LL), rate-of-change trip detection, operator acknowledgment audit trails, audio chimes, and persistent IndexedDB FIFO logging.

title: High-Performance Trend Historian
summary: Client-side high-throughput time-series trend historian with sub-second logging, multi-pen chart overlays, LTTB lossless visual downsampling, and instant CSV/Excel audit sheet export.

title: Fault Detection & Diagnostics (FDD) & Predictive Maintenance (CBM)
summary: Automated AST rule engine for continuous anomaly detection (e.g. Chiller overheat with low water flow, AHU filter clogging, pump cavitation). Computes real-time financial waste rates ($/₹ per hour) and generates automated SOP work orders.

title: Industrial AI Assistant & Natural Language Reporter
summary: Industrial AI Copilot supporting multi-provider LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, Ollama) with client-side WebCrypto encryption. Features ReAct agentic reasoning, telemetry compaction, offline RAG, and automated engineering reports.

title: Cybersecurity & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
summary: Comprehensive plant security with Dual-Key Token-Bucket rate limiting, brute-force lockout, configurable password expiry tenures (30-365 days / never), and granular role permissions (Admin, Supervisor, Operator).
